entities.name: T3512 value
entities.description: Timer value IE used in registration procedures to indicate the periodic registration timer duration.

entities.name: Mobility and periodic registration update procedure
entities.description: Procedure for mobility updates and periodic registration updates over 3GPP access.

entities.name: 5GS registration type
entities.description: IE indicating the type of registration procedure.

entities.name: Registration type not periodic
entities.description: Condition when 5GS registration type IE does not indicate periodic registration updating.

entities.name: Registration type is periodic
entities.description: Condition when 5GS registration type IE indicates periodic registration updating.

relations.description: Registration procedure includes T3512 value IE when registration type is not periodic.
Mobility and periodic registration update procedure may include T3512 value IE when registration type is periodic.
Condition that registration type is not periodic guards the inclusion of T3512 value IE in registration procedure.
Condition that registration type is periodic guards the optional inclusion of T3512 value IE in mobility and periodic registration update procedure.
5GS registration type IE establishes the condition when registration type is not periodic.
5GS registration type IE establishes the condition when registration type is periodic.
